payload.description_html: Paludohadros is an iguanodontian dinosaur that lived during the Early Cretaceous period in what is now England. A basal hardosauroid, it had traits resembling an intermediary stage between iguanodontids and the more derived hadrosaurs. Paludohadros was a medium-sized dinosaur, growing to about 5 m in total body length, and weighing around 2 t.
